_note: One fixed Postgres workload, committed before any price was looked up. Video 107 compared managed against self-hosted; this compares managed against managed, which is a different question and has a different answer.
name: A production Postgres database
assumptions: Always on. Scale-to-zero changes the answer completely and is handled as its own sweep rather than folded into the headline.
One region, US East. No read replicas, no multi-AZ, no reserved or committed-use pricing.
Where a vendor bundles storage or egress into a plan, the bundle is recorded and the overshoot noted rather than silently credited.
Postgres only. Vendors selling a Postgres-compatible engine rather than Postgres are marked as such.
Backups at 7 days retention where the vendor charges for them separately.
